bibl.title: A Demotic Papyrus with a Project for a Relief in the Bancroft Library (P.Tebt.Frag. 14,291 + 14,292).
bibl.seg: Paola Davoli & Didier Devauchelle, A Demotic Papyrus with a Project for a Relief in the Bancroft Library (P.Tebt.Frag. 14,291 + 14,292).

Sandra L. Lippert, Maren Schentuleit & Martin A. Stadler (edd.), avec la collaboration de Till Dävel, Sapientia Felicitas. Festschrift für Günter Vittmann zum 29. Februar 2016 = CENiM. 14 (Montpellier, 2016) pp. 67-79, figg.
bibl.note: P. Berkeley Tebt. Frag. Inv. 14291 + 14292. Drawing of a female figure on a squared grid, interpreted as a project for a relief. The profile of the goddess / queen suggests a date between the 3rd and the 2nd century BCE. - 1. P.D., Introduction. - 2. P.D., The recto. - 3. D.D., Les signes démotiques sur le recto. - 4. D.D., Le texte sur le verso.
